summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories furnished a Form 6-K reporting that the USFDA completed a Pre-Approval Inspection at its FTO-9 manufacturing facility in Visakhapatnam from October 8-9, 2026, issuing a Form 483 with three observations. The company states it will address the observations within the stipulated timeline. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine regulatory manufacturing-compliance disclosure; the risk-arb angle is limited to potential ANDA approval delays or remediation costs rather than any transaction outcome.
